rationale: S-0083-02 proposes motif clustering on the 18-cell t0083 Pareto front in the 54-d parameter space (k-means + hierarchical clustering, silhouette + BIC for k selection). t0086 (robustness_cluster_bio_comparison, this brainstorm session's primary commission, source_suggestion S-0083-02) covers this analysis exactly in its Phase B, applied to a stricter subset (Genuine cells only, after Phase A robustness filtering at 24 dirs x 30 seeds x 5 outer-seed reps) with a richer technique stack (k-means + hierarchical with cosine and euclidean metrics + UMAP + t-SNE) and the additional biological-comparison Phase C overlaid on top. Rejecting as covered by t0086.
